knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Checking a licence is a record that it was checked. It does not grant any authority to carry out work.
A shortfall is recorded at receipt and the person who placed the order is told, so the difference is handled.
A receiving record links each product to its delivery, which supports recall and stock rotation.

practicalCriteria: The learner completes a receiving record for a supplied delivery note and purchase order, showing each difference and the action taken.
The learner traces a supplied product from the receiving record back to its supplier, with the date and quantity.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop using a delivered product that is damaged, leaking or unlabelled until the supervisor has assessed it.
Stop and refer any delivery where the product's safety information is not available.
